short-chat.label: Short chat
short-chat.description: Generated chat prompts of about 512 tokens with answers of up to about 256 tokens.

long-prompt-short-answer.label: Long prompt, short answer
long-prompt-short-answer.description: 8192-token prompts with 128-token answers. Most of the work is prefill.

short-prompt-long-answer.label: Short prompt, long answer
short-prompt-long-answer.description: 256-token prompts with 2048-token answers. Most of the work is decode.

mixed-sizes.label: Mixed request sizes
mixed-sizes.description: A quarter short, half medium and a quarter long requests, drawn at random.

shared-system-prompt.label: Same system prompt on every request
shared-system-prompt.description: Every request starts with the same 2000-token system prompt, followed by a 512-token question.

repeated-documents.label: Questions about a few documents
repeated-documents.description: Each request starts with one of 8 shared 4096-token documents, followed by a 256-token question.

no-prompt-reuse.label: No prompt reuse
no-prompt-reuse.description: 512-token prompts that each start with a unique marker, so no request reuses another's cached prefix.

multi-turn-chat.label: Multi-turn conversations
multi-turn-chat.description: Conversations of about 4 turns with 2 seconds between turns. Each turn resends the conversation so far.

real-chat-prompts.label: Real chat prompts (ShareGPT)
real-chat-prompts.description: Recorded human chat prompts from the ShareGPT dataset, with each answer up to the recorded answer's length.

clients-give-up.label: Clients that give up
clients-give-up.description: Short chat requests where 10% of clients cancel 2 seconds after sending.

recorded-traffic.label: Recorded traffic, original timing
recorded-traffic.description: Replays recorded requests at the times they originally arrived, including bursts and quiet gaps.

recorded-prompts-paced.label: Recorded prompts at a set pace
recorded-prompts-paced.description: Replays recorded prompts whose opening text repeats across requests, at the rate or concurrency you set.

coding-agent-sessions.label: Coding agent sessions
coding-agent-sessions.description: Long coding-agent sessions whose context grows each turn, generated with aiperf synthesize agentic-code.
